text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This paper presents a national-scale, spatially explicit land use change model (LUTO) applied to the entire intensively managed agricultural lands of Australia. The primary research focus is on predicting and simulating future land use and agricultural production scenarios to 2050 under multiple global and domestic drivers. It implements multiple (72) future scenarios with quantitative comparisons of land use change, agricultural outputs, and economic returns. The modeling is spatial with a grid cell resolution (~1.1 km) and outputs include mapped projections of land use transitions. Quantitative results on land use area changes, output rates, production, and value are reported. The study meets all core inclusion criteria and does not meet any exclusion criteria. It is not a review article.)
